events.verdict: Sengun (HOU) brings his hand towards Buzelis' (CHI) side, and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Smith (CHI) initiates contact with Thompson's (HOU) head that affects his shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) directly contests Giddey's (CHI) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Giddey's hand after the release.
Smith (CHI) releases away from Smith Jr. (HOU) to retrieve the long rebound.
Jones (CHI) legally contests Sheppard's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.

Smith (CHI) brings his arm toward Sengun (HOU) while Sengun momentarily grasps Smith's arm, and contact occurs to Sengun's neck/face.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Miller (CHI) establishes himself in Holiday's (HOU) path prior to the contact.
Durant (HOU) directly contests Smith's (CHI) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Smith's hand after the release.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Sheppard (HOU) releases away from Jones (CHI) as Jones moves to set the pick.
Durant (HOU) wraps both hands around Miller's (CHI) body, affecting his FOM off-ball.

Sengun (HOU) contests Buzelis' (CHI) shot attempt and contact occurs to Buzelis' head after he releases the shot attempt.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Durant (HOU) extends his hands into Buzelis (CHI) and delivers contact that affects his ability to defend.
Coach Udoka (HOU) is assessed a technical foul for directing profanity at the officials.  This is his second technical foul and he is ejected from the game.
Thompson (HOU) commits a take foul on Sexton (CHI).
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
